findings.title: Distinguish cached empty content from a cache miss.
findings.rationale: Line 26 treats "" as a miss. If Render returns an empty page, line 32 caches it, but every later request renders it again. Use the cache presence result, or an equivalent API, to distinguish a missing key from a cached empty page.
